text:
Ravi P: heads up  p99 on host ingress jumped ~10% after yesterday's kernel-selection tweak + reduced preparse timeout. looks concentrated on streaming/small payload paths.

Elaine M: any flamegraphs or perf samples?

Ravi P: quick sample from a canary host:

Ravi P: ```
writev                 38.9%  (syscall)
tokenizer::normalize   20.1%  (host/tokenizer.cc:196)
parse_fsm::next        11.7%  (host/parse_fsm.cc:101)
kernel_selector         6.8%  (runtime/kernel_selector.cc)
kvcache::lookup        4.4%
other                  18.1%
```

Marta G: writev dominating suggests tiny-fragment flushes. did preparse timeout go down?

Ravi P: yes, 2ms -> 0.4ms to reduce latency, but it increased number of small frames (median ~110B). also kernel-selector now biases short seqs to slim-kernel which seems to increase host memory-walks.

Connor H: kvcache hit-rate during canary? any rebalance?

Ravi P: there was a shard reassignment at 03:12 UTC, hit-rate dropped 87% -> 60% for ~90s. combo of cold misses + different kernel warmed path = amplification.

Elaine M: short-term mitigation ideas: 1) pin kernel selector to previous policy for routes with streaming=true, 2) enable host-proxy write coalescing (buffer 1ms or 512B), 3) add lightweight kvcache prewarm on shard reassignment.

Marta G: agreed. coalescing is low-risk and should reduce writev count significantly.

Ravi P: prototyped coalesce=1ms in host-proxy: writev count down ~6x locally, p99 down ~7%. repro steps I used:

Ravi P: ```bash
wrk -t4 -c300 -d20s --script=stream_small.lua http://localhost:8080
strace -f -e trace=writev -p $(pidof host-proxy) | head -n 50
```

devops-bot: deploy started host-proxy/coalesce-1ms canary -> 5% hosts. CI: https://ci.example/7854

Connor H: also add telemetry (writev_count, avg_frag_size, kvcache_hit_rate, kernel_by_route). we need a quick dashboard for the canary.

Elaine M: for kvcache prewarm: async fanout of top-150 recent keys after shard reassign, rate-limited to avoid thundering. cheap and should cut the cold miss spike.

Marta G: note: tokenizer normalization holds a mutex in current impl; many tiny streams cause contention. longer term: switch to lock-free small-buf path or increase tokenizer worker threads for streaming routes. but defer for now.

Ravi P: action items:
- Ravi: PR for host-proxy coalesce (1ms/512B) + canary flag
- Ravi: small PR to pin kernel-selector for streaming routes (route.metadata.streaming == true)
- Ravi: implement lightweight kvcache prewarm on shard reassign
- Connor: add telemetry + grafana panel and temp alert (p99 + writev surge)
- Elaine: add short-seq streaming perf check to CI (stream_small.lua)

Marta G: set auto-rollback if canary p99 increases >5% or writev_count > 3x baseline.

Ravi P: thanks all. i'll upload perf dumps and strace to the PR. :thumbsup:

Connor H: :rocket:

Elaine M: will add CI job tomorrow morning.
